note: check=deterministic rules run in code (craft standards check, no model) on NEW code only; check=llm rules are judged by the quality-gate agent. Keep deterministic rules conservative: a false FAIL costs a resend.

rules.text: a source file must not cross 1500 lines; split into components, hooks or services
no `any`: create the right type (use `unknown` in catch)
a component or hook stays near 150 lines and has one subject; well above that, extract subcomponents or sub-hooks
components, hooks, props and handlers have descriptive names; no abbreviations or generic names (data, handler, temp)
queries, mutations, forms and toasts follow the project's pattern (TanStack Query, shadcn/ui, services layer), not a new ad hoc way
reuse an existing hook, component or util from the Reuse map before creating a new one
anything visible follows the project's style guide or design system (colors, typography, spacing, dialogs)
